stage1.note: default elimination lines; apply only if molecular (organic additive) candidates arise via Stage-2 escalation

meta.task: Design a battery for a smartphone: volumetric energy density >= 950 Wh/L, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 50 degC, anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles, voltage plateau >= 4.1 V.
meta.start_stage_basis: task text names no new materials/additives/electrolyte design (pure performance objective) -> Stage-3 cell-design entry per SKILL.md Sec 0 rule 2; opening ceiling assessment may escalate to Stage 2 (system switch) since ceiling_escalation=on
meta.base_params_basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 with record (SKILL.md Sec 1.5)

ablation.exploration_force: on (benchmark default; task text does not disable)

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (task text silent -> widest interpretation; default Chen2020, system switch allowed and expected for 4.1 V plateau)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (task text silent -> widest interpretation; sigma/t+ transport overrides)
freedoms.electrode_modification: adjustable (task text silent -> widest interpretation; SEI-suppressing coating bridge)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable (task text silent -> widest interpretation; thickness/porosity/N-P/separator/current collector/particle size)
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (task text silent -> widest interpretation; cooling coefficient)

unit_notes.T_max: 50 degC -> 323.15 K, evaluated from 4C_charge_45C output T_max_K with thermal lumped (task couples max temperature with 4C fast charge)
unit_notes.plateau: voltage plateau >= 4.1 V mapped to calc-energy midpoint_voltage_v (voltage at discharge-time midpoint = plateau-voltage approximation)
unit_notes.SEI: anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles mapped to aging_1C_100cyc output key sei_thickness_nm_end (100 cycles, 1C, 25 degC, per task text)

meta.safety_scenarios: 4C fast charge no plating + T_max only; no overcharge/nail/thermal-runaway scenarios in task text
